transcript.content: Hello. I am Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hello. I guess... I'm here because things have been weird at work. I'm a buyer, and... I don't know. I just can't shake this feeling that people there, and maybe some of the vendors, are tracking what I buy. Like they're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor showed me the reports and said they don't prove anything, but... I don't know. It just feels like it's happening.
Have you been hearing any voices or sounds that other people around you don't seem to hear?

Um... yeah, I guess. Just sometimes. Like... if I'm in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting. I'll hear... a guy's voice. 

It sounds like he's right behind me. He just says things like, 'Move faster, Scott,' or... he laughs at my picks. But when I turn around to look... nobody's there.
How long have you been experiencing these feelings about your coworkers and hearing this voice?
Um... I guess... maybe about ten months? Yeah, roughly ten months that this stuff has been going on.

Beyond these concerns at work and the voice you hear, have you noticed any changes in your ability to take care of yourself, such as difficulty with personal hygiene or a loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Um... I don't know. I guess I don't really do much anymore. 

When I have days off, I just... I stay in my apartment. I'll sit there and scroll through sneaker drops on my phone, but... I don't even really care about them right now. 

And, um... my friends will text me about playing volleyball or going to gallery nights, like we used to. But I just... I dodge their texts. It just feels like... too much work to even answer them. So I just don't.
When you are talking to your friends or colleagues, have they mentioned that your sentences sometimes don't make sense or that you seem to jump between unrelated topics?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I don't talk to them much anyway, like I said. So... they haven't said anything like that to me.

Have you noticed any times where your behavior has become very strange, such as moving in unusual ways, staying frozen in one position for a long time, or acting in a way that others might find completely bizarre?
Um... no. I don't... I don't think so. I haven't done anything like that. Just... mostly staying in my apartment.

Are you concerned that people outside of your workplace, such as neighbors, strangers on the street, or even people on the news, are also involved in tracking you or trying to interfere with your life?
Um... no. I haven't noticed anything like that. It's... it's just work. I don't really pay attention to my neighbors or people on the street. So, no.
When you are speaking, do you ever find that your thoughts feel jumbled or that you have trouble keeping your focus on what you intend to say?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed. I usually know what I'm trying to say. I just... I don't really talk enough for that to be a problem, I guess. So, no.
Have you ever experienced periods of time where your mood was so low that you felt hopeless or unable to function, or periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or impulsive?

Um... I guess sometimes I get these stretches where I feel... really good. Like the whole city is just opening up for me, you know? But... if someone at work questions a purchase order or tells me to slow down, I... I snap at them. Way harder than I mean to. So... yeah, I guess that happens.

During those times when you felt unusually energetic and talkative, did the feelings that people at work were tracking you get significantly worse, or did they persist at the same level as they do when your mood is more neutral?

Um... maybe worse? I guess. Like... there were a few weeks where I was barely sleeping. I just kept talking nonstop about sneaker trends, and I felt... untouchable at work. But... yeah, at the same time, I was convinced the vendors were manipulating the numbers on me. And... I don't know, I would sometimes hear that voice, too. Just... pushing me to move faster.
Have there been periods where you felt so down, hopeless, or empty that you lost interest in almost everything for at least two weeks at a time?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I mean, I have bad days like anyone else, but... not for two weeks straight or anything like that. Just... normal stuff, I guess.

Are there any periods of time, lasting at least two weeks, where you experienced these thoughts about work being tracked and heard that voice, but your mood felt relatively stable and you were not feeling that 'untouchable' energy?

Yeah... I guess so. There was a time... a few weeks, maybe. I was sleeping fine, not feeling all... wired. Just normal, I think. But... I still thought they were watching my buys. And... I still heard it. The voice. When I was in the stockroom. So, yeah. Even when I was calm.
